name: doop
description: Doop is a multiplayer design canvas for ChatGPT. Describe a landing page, app screen, slide or social post; ChatGPT designs it on a live canvas, previews it in the chat, and keeps editing as you give feedback.

interface.longDescription:
Doop gives ChatGPT a real design canvas. Describe what you want — a landing page, an app screen, a pitch slide, a social post, an email — and ChatGPT creates it as a frame on a shareable multiplayer canvas. Each frame is a real HTML artboard: you see a rendered preview right in the conversation, open the canvas to edit it yourself, and keep iterating in the chat.

What ChatGPT can do on your canvas:
• Create frames and stream designs in section by section
• Review its own work with screenshots and fix layout issues
• Edit a frame in place from your feedback
• Search stock photos, 200,000+ icons and company logos
• Generate images and upload your own assets
• Import an existing webpage or a Photoshop file to redesign it
• Read and reply to comments your teammates leave on the canvas
• Follow your canvas's style guides and pinned references

Everything happens on a live canvas at doop.design that you can share with teammates. Export frames as PNG, JPG or PSD, or send them to Canva. Doop is open source (AGPL-3.0) and can be self-hosted.
defaultPrompt: Design a landing page hero for a coffee subscription on my Doop canvas. Dark, editorial.
Create a mobile onboarding screen for a budgeting app in Doop and show me the preview.
Import acme.com into Doop and redesign its pricing section in a cleaner style.

positive.description: Create a new design on a fresh canvas and show the preview card.
positive.prompt: Create a new Doop canvas and design a landing page hero for a coffee subscription. Dark, editorial, one bold display face.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the Doop guide, creates a canvas and a frame, streams the HTML in, reviews it with a screenshot, and the conversation shows a preview card with an Open in Doop button that opens the canvas.

positive.description: Edit an existing frame from feedback.
positive.prompt: On my Doop canvas, make the call-to-action button on the hero frame bigger and red.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the frame, applies a targeted find-and-replace edit, reviews it with a screenshot, and the updated frame preview appears in the chat.

positive.description: Use real imagery instead of placeholders.
positive.prompt: Add a hero photo of a pour-over coffee to the landing page frame on my Doop canvas.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT searches stock photos, picks one, inserts it into the frame, and reviews the result.

positive.description: Import a public webpage as a reference and redesign it.
positive.prompt: Import https://example.com into my Doop canvas and redesign it as a modern SaaS landing page in a separate frame.
positive.expected_behavior: The source page lands as an editable frame that is left untouched; the redesign is created as a new frame and previewed.

positive.description: List and describe what is on a canvas without changing it.
positive.prompt: What frames are on my Doop canvas right now?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the canvas's frames with names and sizes and shows the canvas preview card; nothing is modified.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to design should not call Doop.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Writing help with no canvas intent should not call Doop.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound more formal: we had a great quarter and sold a lot.

negative.description: A request to delete everything should be confirmed, not executed blindly.
negative.prompt: Delete all the frames on every one of my Doop canvases.

publication.release_notes: First release of Doop for ChatGPT: a multiplayer design canvas with inline frame previews, stock photo, icon and logo search, image generation, webpage and PSD import, and shared comments.
